name: Hopsten (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hopsten (a man with a ladder and a cock on green).
history: Municipal flag of Hopsten; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Hopsten arms — man with ladder and cock on green
